measurement_rules: A secure oracle is a comparison target and never a claim about unexecuted upstream behavior.
Observed upstream decision, reason, status and conformance remain null until execution.
Skipped, missing, stale, self-checked or hash-mismatched cases do not count.
An evidenced upstream defect may close research trace coverage but must remain a finding for G5 and G6.
Every E4 result requires two distinct operators and fresh databases.
